title: Reviewer lens: routine operations scale with changed or pending work, not total history (a full read needs a stated reason and measured bounds)
outcome: Reviewer lens: routine operations scale with changed or pending work, not total history (a full read needs a stated reason and measured bounds)
acceptance: The Rust and TypeScript reviewer lenses under .claude/reviewers/ contain a short rule: a routine or periodic operation (tick, rescan, recovery, sync, list, snapshot) does work proportional to what changed or is genuinely pending, not to the total accumulated history. Where a full read is unavoidable, the change states why and gives a measured bound (rows, time, memory) at a realistic size. The text has no quotes or conversation history.
The change lands under the standing rule, with the review pair clean and the full gate green. No test reads or pins the lens text.
